nom: Exuviance Performance Peel AP25 At-Home Facial Peel

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea-prone or reactive skin, report little to no irritation and describe the peel as surprisingly gentle, with benefits like reduced redness, smaller-looking pores, and softer texture; a few dissent, including one whose skin broke out after the first use and another whose very sensitive skin became noticeably dry and light-sensitive for two days after a stronger reaction.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin are split: one broke out after her first use and found the glycolic-acid formula too harsh, while another says it does not dry her skin out and leaves her texture visibly smoother.
segments.mature: The reviewer who describes shopping for 'middle age' skin says she saw a visible difference after two at-home uses, and another in her forties and fifties with decades of sun exposure says the peel has faded almost all of her dark spots.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report smoother texture and visibly reduced fine lines with regular use, including one who tested the product on the back of her hand and says it noticeably softened wrinkles there; several add that real results take weeks of consistent use to appear.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the peel does not dry out their skin and some describe it as leaving skin more hydrated and glowy, but one reviewer with sensitive skin found the stronger version dried her skin out noticeably and required a heavier moisturizer afterward.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers say the peel calms existing redness or causes none at all, but a few report mild redness or slight peeling in the day or so after use, particularly on the first application.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer switching from a competing peel says her skin barrier feels more hydrated and glowy with this product.
concerns.spots: Reviewers consistently report dark spots and discoloration fading with consistent use over weeks, including one who says decades of sun damage on her face has almost completely cleared, though several note the change is gradual rather than immediate.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers say the peel reduces breakouts, including hormonal and congestion-related ones, and helps fade post-acne marks, but one reviewer with combination skin broke out in new areas after her very first use and stopped using it.

aspects.libelle: Mild tingling or stinging during use
Simple two-step pad system, no mess
Some pads arrive already dried out

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] These weren't for me. I have sensitive combination skin and they broke me out after the first use. The formula is strong with glycolic acid, so maybe too harsh for my skin. I got new pimples in places I don't usually break out. Stopped using and skin calmed down. Might work if your skin tolerates acids well, but patch test first.

extraits.titre: Very strong, and gave me consistent results!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is an intense peel, way more than I even expected. It was so strong that I was super sensitive to even the light coming through my windows for two days, so this is definitely something to consider if you want a powerful but non-harsh peel! The product itself is pretty easy to use and straightforward, and is very mess-free. It caused a little irritation (as in tingling, slight eye irritation, and heat), yet it died down after an hour or so. This did okay in melting through my old acne scars, and found that two peels were needed to lighten them up to 2 levels. Definitely needed some time to "recover" between uses (as in 4-5 days), but it's never caused a burn or too much excessive flaking or peeling the more I use. This does require a strong moisturizer since it dried out my skin pretty noticeably. Would still recommend since it's still effective, though experimenting is needed to see how many peels can work out for you.

I waant so sure about this but i ended up getting it during days of beauty for half off and i love it! I do get professional chemical peels so you can't go into it thinking you'll get that type of result, but I definitely saw a difference in my skin after I used this twice at home. I will definitely be purchasing again if you have sensitive skin, it's actually not bad.On it

I always scroll through reviews hoping they arent bots.. but I tried this years ago and love it! I have combination skin and it doesnt dry me out. I do it once a year and get it while its on sale! My skin texture is gone and i look glowy. Worth a try if your skin can tolerate it!

I spent my teenage years frying my body at the beach, my thirties in a tanning bed and my forties and fifties on the back of a Harley riding in the desert heat and I have dark spots on my face from no sunscreen. I kid you not this peel has erased almost all of them with scrapping. This is my second box of these and I use them once a week and will continue until they are gone.

I received a sample peel and after using it, had to buy a full pack! I look forward to using the peel each week! They have helped with my redness and fading post-acne marks and are not harsh on my sensitive skin. I am also seeing improvement on my fine lines.

extraits.titre: It works, but it is pricey
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] OK, I wanted to wait to review this product until I've used it a few times. So far I've used it four times and I feel like it really does smooth the texture of my skin, slightly brighten dark spots and definitely exfoliates the surface. You would think that the little pad that they provide wouldn't be enough product, but it's a perfect amount. As soon as you put it on, you don't feel a tingling right away but after a few minutes and it starts to dry you definitely feel a slight sting. I kept it on for the full 10 minutes each time. Neutralizing is very easy and uses the same type of pad. After a day or so my skin did get a little red and slightly peeled the first time but there's basically no downtime. I moisturized after so that helped. I definitely like the product and I think it does what it says it's supposed to do but the price is a little high.
